content:
We got search results: three templates. The first one reaction_id 1914386 with retro_smarts_template etc. That seems to be a cycloaddition involving an alkyne and an ester? Let's examine: retro_smarts_template: '[C;D1;H3:9]-[#14:10](-[C;D1;H3:11])(-[C;D1;H3:12])-[C;H0;D3;+0:13]1=[CH;D2;+0:14]-[C;H0;D4;+0:1]-1(/[CH;D2;+0:2]=[CH;D2;+0:3]/[c:4])-[C:5](=[O;D1;H0:6])-[#8:7]-[C;D1;H3:8]>>O=[C;H0;D3;+0:1](-[CH2;D2;+0:2]-[CH2;D2;+0:3]-[c:4])-[C:5](=[O;D1;H0:6])-[#8:7]-[C;D1;H3:8].[C;D1;H3:9]-[#14:10](-[C;D1;H3:11])(-[C;D1;H3:12])-[C;H0;D2;+0:13]#[CH;D1;+0:14]'

So forward reaction (right side to left side) is: reactants: O=[C]... (an ester?) plus alkyne with Si? The product is the cyclized product with Si and aromatic etc. This matches our target. So template_id is reaction_id 1914386. We need template_id field likely expects integer? In examples they used numeric. So we can use "template_id": 1914386.

Now we need to apply this template to target to get precursors. Use apply_template with target SMILES and template_id 1914386.
